desc: Tanfoglio's Force Duty Tactical takes the trusted performance of the Force Duty to a new level, maintaining the original quality while delivering cutting-edge enhancements tailored for tactical excellence. Designed with the modern shooter in mind, new features include a threaded barrel, offering compatibility with suppressors and muzzle devices for unparalleled versatility. Its precision-engineered tactical grips include an integrated magwell for swift, confident reloads, while the XL base pad provides enhanced capacity and handling under any conditions.
